risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides detailed operating, balance-sheet, acquisition, and credit-quality metrics. Risk tone is moderately cautious, reflecting pandemic-related deterioration, higher credit-loss provisions, rising nonperforming assets, regulatory uncertainty, and acquisition-integration risk, though management emphasizes strong liquidity and strategic positioning. Repeated strategic-goal language and broad contingencies add some boilerplate and limit specificity around future downside scenarios.
